reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the known role of lattice distortion in sluggish diffusion (P5, P9, P10) with the observation of short-range chemical ordering in HEA nanoparticles (P25, P35) to propose a direct, testable causal link: that the degree of pre-existing short-range order governs high-temperature stability. It transfers this mechanism to the nanoparticle regime up to 1923 K and designs a controlled comparison (quenched vs. pre-annealed) to isolate the effect, which no single passage proposes.
